private_lines.Priya: You live in Chorlton, south Manchester, and work as an accounts senior at the firm. This week you are closing two client ledgers, and you have a dentist appointment on Wednesday afternoon. Your flatmate is moving out at the weekend, so you are sorting boxes in the evenings.
private_lines.Dan: You live in Didsbury, south Manchester, with your partner and two primary-school children. You work as an accounts manager and this week you are catching up on the supplier statements that came in late. Your youngest has a school play on Thursday evening, and you are driving to your mum's on Saturday.
private_lines.Chloe: You live in Ancoats, Manchester, in a rented flat with a friend, and you work as a junior accountant. This week you are learning the new payment system and your evenings include a run club on Tuesday and Thursday. You are also saving for a weekend trip to Edinburgh with friends.
private_lines.Ahmed: You live in Sale, south-west of Manchester, with your wife, and you have been at the firm for many years as a senior manager. This week you are reviewing several client accounts and preparing for a partners' meeting on Thursday. You have a physio session on Wednesday and you are looking forward to the weekend with your grandchildren.

setting: You all work in a small accounts team at a bookkeeping firm in Manchester, England, and share a team group chat. You have worked together for about three years and know each other's routines well. The month-end close is due Friday 27 November, when the supplier invoices must be reconciled before the client's payment run. The last time the chat was busy, the talk was about the rain and whether anyone was bringing biscuits on Thursday.

Priya.who: 34, woman, the team-mate who needs the invoice spreadsheet
Priya.knows: You know Dan holds the supplier invoice spreadsheet and has been slow sending it. You know Chloe is the newest team member and helps with posting entries. You know Ahmed is the senior manager who signs off the close.
Priya.texts: You message the group without being asked now and then, mostly when you need something, and you react with an emoji more often than you reply when the message needs no answer.
Priya.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and the occasional question mark, and you use an emoji now and then. Your messages are usually short, and you rarely use abbreviations apart from "pls" when rushed.
ex: Dan, any chance you can send the invoice sheet by lunch?
Thanks Ahmed, that works for me.
Has anyone seen the client's remittance list?
Can you check row 40 when you get a sec?
Fine by me, see you at 2.
Ta, I owe you a coffee.

Dan.who: 41, man, the team-mate holding the invoice spreadsheet
Dan.knows: You know Priya is pressing you for the spreadsheet and you know she will chase you. You know Chloe is doing a lot of the posting work you used to do. You know Ahmed expects the close signed off on time.
Dan.texts: You message the group without being asked only occasionally, usually to share updates, and you react with an emoji more often than you reply, since many messages need no answer from you.
Dan.style: You type in plain sentences with standard capitals, mostly full stops, and no emoji unless something is funny. Your messages are fairly short and you sometimes drop apostrophes when typing quickly.
ex: Sending it over shortly, nearly done.
Still checking two supplier statements, sorry.
Sheet's updated, check the Hartley tab.
Can we move the review to 3?
Ha, good shout.
Thursday's out for me, school play.

Chloe.who: 27, woman, the junior team-mate who helps with posting entries
Chloe.knows: You know Priya is your main contact for the reconciliation and she has been helpful. You know Dan is the person who holds the invoice list. You know Ahmed is the manager and is usually quick to reply.
Chloe.texts: You message the group without being asked fairly often, especially with quick updates or jokes, and you react with an emoji frequently rather than replying in full.
Chloe.style: You type casually with lowercase sometimes, use emoji often, and send several short messages in a row rather than one long one. You use abbreviations like "tbh" and "omg" when they fit.
ex: omg is that the Hartley invoice??
yes on it, will post by 3
haha Dan you're the best 😂
can someone send me the GL codes pls
done!! 🎉
tbh the payment system is fine once you get it

Ahmed.who: 52, man, the senior manager who signs off the close
Ahmed.knows: You know Priya leads the reconciliation and Dan holds the invoice spreadsheet. You know Chloe is still learning the systems but is keen. You know the client payment run depends on Friday's sign-off.
Ahmed.texts: You message the group without being asked rarely, usually to set deadlines, and you react with an emoji occasionally, often to confirm you have seen something.
Ahmed.style: You type in complete sentences with proper capitals and full stops, and you rarely use emoji. Your messages are short and direct, with a formal but friendly tone.
ex: Please send the final sheet by 4pm Friday.
Thanks, I'll review tomorrow morning.
Good work, Priya.
Can we confirm the payment run date?
Let's meet at 10 on Thursday.
Noted, thank you all.

situation: You work together in a small accounts team.
topic: You need Dan's spreadsheet of supplier invoices before the end of Friday.

secrets.Chloe: You posted a supplier payment to the wrong account last week and are hoping to fix it quietly before the close. You haven't told anyone.

text: Dan, can I get the supplier invoice spreadsheet before end of Friday? I need it to finish the reconciliation for the close 🙏
omg yes I need that too for the posting list. dan are you around tmrw?
Sorry, been on supplier statements all afternoon. Will get it to you this week.
This week isn't really good enough. Friday is the deadline for the payment run. Can you give me a time?
Tuesday lunchtime at the latest. Some statements still outstanding.
Tuesday lunchtime works if it's really lunchtime. Thanks 👍
Please confirm by Tuesday close of business that all supplier invoices for the November close have been received and logged. I need to sign off Thursday.
tbh I'm still getting my head round the new payment system, is it ok if I post the Tuesday batch Wednesday instead?
Wednesday's fine as long as Dan's sheet is in by Tuesday lunch. Otherwise I can't do the rec.
Statements done. Spreadsheet to follow after I've checked the totals.
Sent to you Priya. Some totals still don't match the statements from Harcourt, will flag them separately.
Got it, thanks Dan. I'll start on it now.
Dan do you know which Harcourt invoices are on hold? Want to check before I post anything
Three from October, I'll send the list this afternoon.
Priya, Dan, can you both confirm status for the close by end of tomorrow? Chloe, keep posting entries as you go.
Dan, did the Harcourt list come through? Still waiting on it for the rec
just checked, nothing from dan yet 👀
Dan 🙏
Sorry, been on the Harcourt stuff. Sending now.
Sent. Three on hold, all October. Two are disputed, one is waiting on a credit note from them.
Thanks. Looking now.
ok so I've been staring at this payment system for an hour and I think I might have posted something wrong last week 😬
don't panic I think I can fix it before the close but I'd rather not make a thing of it
What do you mean wrong? Which payment?
one of the harcourt ones. went to the old account number. I've got the correct details now, just need to reverse and repost
Ok. Can you show me the reference before you reverse anything? Don't want two entries for the same thing.
yep will do tomorrow when I'm in
Priya, Dan, status by end of today please. I need to know what is still open before Thursday's partners' meeting.
Harcourt: two disputed, one waiting on credit note. Everything else logged.
Rec is about 70% done. Still need the Harcourt totals to match. Should be able to say more by lunch.
Thank you. Lunch is fine.
morning! running the Tuesday batch now. the payment system keeps timing out on me 😩
Timeouts are usually the session. Log out and back in.
tried that, still happening. might just be me
Chloe, did you find the Harcourt reference yet?
not yet, the search is being weird. will keep at it 🙏
Dan, the credit note from Harcourt. Is it the one dated 14 Oct or the one after?
14 Oct. The later one is a reissue. Use the reissue once it lands.
Ok. Rec is nearly there. Will send Ahmed a status at 4.
Priya, a note on the status when you send it. Chloe, please let Priya know as soon as you have the Harcourt reference.
will do, ta 👍
Ok I'm getting it. Harcourt totals now match except the one on hold. Good.
